messages.content: I prefer a one-bedroom apartment near downtown San Jose.

Thank you for adding your preferences for in-unit laundry and a safe neighborhood. Based on your criteria—$2,400 monthly budget, one-bedroom apartment near downtown San Jose, in-unit laundry, and a safe neighborhood—I can now refine my search. Would you like me to proceed with finding listings that match these requirements?
I do not want a shared room.

I understand that you do not want a shared room. Based on your current criteria—$2,400 monthly budget, one-bedroom apartment near downtown San Jose, in-unit laundry, and a safe neighborhood—I will ensure the search includes only private one-bedroom apartments. Would you like me to proceed with finding listings that match these requirements?
My preferred move-in date is November 15, 2026.

Your preferred move-in date is November 15, 2026. I will include this date in the search criteria when looking for available listings that match your requirements. Would you like me to proceed with finding options that fit your criteria?

I will include this as part of the search criteria when looking for suitable one-bedroom apartments near downtown San Jose within your $2,400 monthly budget, with in-unit laundry and a safe neighborhood.
